channel.title: Proverbs for Men: A Chapter a Day
channel.copyright: Narration and original text © 2026 Honest Little Apps. Scripture: World English Bible (public domain).
channel.description:
Read the book of Proverbs in a month, one chapter a day, the way men have done for centuries: the chapter that matches today's date. Each episode is the full chapter read aloud from the World English Bible (public domain), followed by one verse to carry and one practical action for the day. About three minutes. No ads, no politics, no sales pitch in the middle.

Made by Honest Little Apps, the makers of FORGED: Daily Bible for Men, a free 90-day Bible plan for men on iPhone (Day 1 free, no account needed). FORGED: Daily Bible for Men on the App Store

Narrated with a synthetic (text-to-speech) voice.
